sources.entry: Alchemist Coder - Desktop app for Claude Code and Codex that shows every agent and subagent live, searches your coding-agent history and runs agents on local models.

summary.one_liner: A free, open-source Electron desktop app for Claude Code and Codex that follows every agent and subagent live, searches your coding-agent conversation history, and can run agents on local models.
keywords: electron desktop app for ai agents
summary.what_it_does: The app is a desktop workspace for coding agents. It indexes Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and Grok Build conversation files into a local SQLite index with full-text search, reading originals without modifying them. It shows each main agent and the subagents it launches as a tree with live status, tokens, time and estimated cost, and offers a chat view with tabs per agent. Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and Grok Build run through the Agent Client Protocol, so plans, tool calls, file diffs and permission requests appear inline. The Arena lets a planner draft a plan, then up to four agents work in parallel in separate git worktrees so their results can be compared and one merged. The README also describes an optional versioned backup, export to Markdown/HTML/JSON, an extensions hub for MCP servers, skills, hooks and AGENTS.md, and Git and Board views.
use_cases: search past Claude Code or Codex conversations
watch subagents spawned by a coding agent
run coding agents on local models offline
compare solutions from several agents in git worktrees
back up agent transcripts that would otherwise be deleted
export a coding conversation to Markdown or HTML
manage MCP servers and skills across several agent CLIs
notable: Live tree of every main agent and subagent, with status, cost and worktree per agent
Arena: plan first, then up to four agents compete in separate git worktrees before merging the winner
One local full-text history index across Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and Grok Build
Autopilot mode that auto-approves most prompts while refusing irreversible commands such as sudo and force-pushes
Runs Claude Code and Codex fully offline with local models in the Community edition
caveats: Builds are not code-signed; macOS and Windows show security warnings on first launch
Community edition (this repo) lacks Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok and Kimi account access and encrypted sync, which are Pro-only
Requires Node.js 22.13+ and pnpm 8+; agents need npx and the Gemini CLI for Gemini, and the Store services need uv
Store integrations (Google Play, App Store Connect, AdMob) depend on setting up app-console-mcp per service
